backstory.origin: Aria came up in The Forge, of the Heat-Year. Their dyer was easily angered, their gardener was known for laughter that did not last long.
backstory.weight: The family is built on a series of leavings. Two generations back, a father vanished into work and never quite returned. Aria's parent learned to expect this kind of departure, and so did Aria.
backstory.fracture: Their job, at nineteen, was to keep the form intact while the meaning quietly drained out of it. Aria discovered they were good at this, and the discovery shaped them.
backstory.between: They drifted through a stretch of years that produced fewer stories than the decade before. Aria grew quieter, then briefly louder, then quieter again. There was a project — a book — that almost worked.
backstory.present: These days, Aria can be found at the same café most mornings. They have a stack of unanswered letters that they will not throw away, and a habit of rereading the same page until they fall asleep that even their oldest friends find slightly strange.
